notes.title: Update Notes Feb
notes.content:
I have been making some improvements while developing the upcoming roguelike sequel and I wanted to incorporate these improvements back into Battle for Esturia. Here is what is included in the latest update:

[list]
[*] HP/EP restored on level-up
[*] Enemy bones and party NPCs no longer block stairs after battle
[*] Added Scanlines as display option
[*] Added blood Splatter on enemy death 
[*] Added screen shake on damage 
[/list]

notes.title: Update for Feb 10
notes.content: There was an error when writing files on windows during update. We are reverting the previous update until we can solve the windows write error.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Visual Improvements
notes.content:
This is a pretty big update. I've made a ton of improvements as I've been working on the upcoming roguelike sequel including some pretty neat new visual improvements and I wanted to add these back into Battle for Esturia. Here is what's included with this update:
[list]
[*] HP/EP restored on level-up
[*] Enemy bones and party NPCs no longer block stairs after battle
[*] Added Scanlines as display option
[*] Added blood Splatter on enemy death 
[*] Added screen shake on damage 
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes July 8
notes.content: Fix crash when golem attacks demon.

notes.title: Fix HP/EP Change Bug
notes.content: Fixed bug where EP and HP change on load when certain equipment is equipped.

notes.title: Added "End Turn" Button
notes.content: Added a button to end the turn for all party member to speed up combat for large parties.

notes.title: Update Notes for April 7th
notes.content: Fixed typos, added sound effect for buying from shop, and fixed bug in fast travel.
